author: abcoathup
content:
We need client teams to be able to log their preferences with the same definitions of priority. One tool, one scale. At the very least add the ability to save preferences and share them, even if just encoded in a URL. 

The prioritisation process for Glamsterdam was not great.  We need a single source of truth for shortlisted candidates. (Hopefully Forkcast).

author: wolovim
content: obvs intend to support the signaling and decision-making process as best i can, but im not advocating for mandating all teams use this. i think youre getting at something deeper/more upstream than this exercise though, re: prioritization
